name: dev_browser_action
description: Operate the current caller development browser; input requires a fresh observation and approval
retry_hint: read the page again to see whether the earlier click or typing already took effect; every click or type needs its own fresh read, so input cannot repeat blindly

selector.description: read: CSS selector; every match is read (default body). click/type: the target, which must lie inside the region your last read covered

preset.description: viewport only: phone 390x844, phone_small 360x640 and tablet 768x1024 emulate touch devices; desktop 1280x900, desktop_wide 1440x900; navigate again afterwards

offset.description: read only: character offset of the next page; use next_offset from a truncated read
